title: Default Credentials — Master Reference by App/Service
body:
When you find a login page, always try default credentials before anything else. This is the single fastest win in any engagement — takes 30 seconds and sometimes hands you the box. The workflow: identify the app/service from nmap (http-title, server header, favicon) or the login page → check this list → try the defaults → if they work, check the version and search for exploits.

If defaults fail, try: admin/admin, admin/password, admin/<blank>, root/root, admin/<appname>, <appname>/<appname>. Also try the hostname and domain name as passwords — they're surprisingly common.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WEB ADMIN PANELS / CMSes
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# WordPress:        admin / admin  (or check wp-config.php)
# Joomla:           admin / admin
# Drupal:           admin / admin
# TYPO3:            admin / password
# DokuWiki:         admin / admin
# Grav CMS:         admin / admin
# PluXml:           admin / admin
# SOPlanning:       admin / admin
# Jorani:           admin / admin
# CODOFORUM:        admin / admin
# Subrion:          admin / admin
# concrete5:        admin / password

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DOWNLOAD MANAGERS / AUTOMATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# pyLoad:           pyload / pyload
# Gerapy:           admin / admin
# Graylog:          admin / admin
# Nextcloud:        admin / admin

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CI/CD / DEVOPS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Jenkins:          admin / <blank>  or  admin / admin
#                   (check /var/jenkins_home/secrets/initialAdminPassword)
# TeamCity:         admin / admin
# GitLab:           root / 5iveL!fe  (older)  or  root / password
# Gitea:            gitea / gitea
# Gogs:             gogs / gogs

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MONITORING / LOGGING
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Grafana:          admin / admin  (forced change on first login)
# Kibana:           elastic / changeme  (or no auth)
# Splunk:           admin / changeme
# Maltrail:         no auth needed for exploit (admin / admin for UI)
# Nagios:           nagiosadmin / nagios
# Zabbix:           Admin / zabbix

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATABASES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MySQL:            root / <blank>  or  root / root
# PostgreSQL:       postgres / postgres
# MongoDB:          <no auth by default>
# Redis:            <no auth by default>  (try: redis-cli -h <IP> ping)
# CouchDB:          admin / admin
# phpMyAdmin:       root / <blank>  or  root / root

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NETWORK / INFRASTRUCTURE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Webmin:           root / <root password>  or  admin / admin
# pfSense:          admin / pfsense
# OpenWrt:          root / <blank>
# MikroTik:         admin / <blank>
# Cisco IOS:        cisco / cisco
# SNMP community:   public / private

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIL / COLLABORATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Roundcube:        admin / admin
# Zimbra:           admin / zimbra
# SmarterMail:      admin / admin
# Openfire:         admin / admin

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# AI / ML / DATA SCIENCE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MLflow:           <no auth by default on port 5000>
# Ray Dashboard:    <no auth by default on port 8265>
# Jupyter Notebook: <token in URL on first launch, or no auth>

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INDUSTRIAL / IOT / DVR
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Argus DVR:        admin / admin  (or no auth)
# ZoneMinder:       admin / admin
# HIKVISION:        admin / 12345
# Dahua:            admin / admin


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# OSCP / PG PRACTICE — COMMONLY SEEN APPS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# These appear repeatedly in OSCP prep boxes and walkthroughs:

# Cacti (network monitoring):    admin / admin
#                                 admin / 1234
# Nagios XI:                      nagiosadmin / admin
#                                 nagiosadmin / nagiosadmin
# Nagios Core:                    nagiosadmin / nagios
# Gogs:                           gogs / gogs  or  admin / admin
# Gitea:                          gitea / gitea  or  admin / admin
#                                 (or self-register — registration often open)
# Mantis Bug Tracker:             administrator / root  or  admin / admin
# Cachet:                         admin / admin
# Cockpit:                        admin / admin  or  system user credentials
# Openfire:                       admin / admin
# ColdFusion:                     admin / admin
# CrushFTP:                       crushadmin / crushadmin
# Bludit CMS:                     admin / admin  or  admin / password
# Bolt CMS:                       admin / admin
# Chamilo LMS:                    admin / admin
# Moodle:                         admin / admin
# Attendance and HRM:             admin / admin  or  admin / 12345
# BookStack:                      admin@admin.com / password
# SeaCMS:                         admin / (check DB — often MD5 or base64)
# H2 Database Console:            sa / (blank)  JDBC URL: jdbc:h2:~/test
# Webmin:                         root / <system root password>
# Netdata:                        admin / netdata  or  no auth
# Portainer:                      admin / admin (first run prompts to set)
# RabbitMQ Management:            guest / guest
# Kafka:                          (no auth by default)
# Solr:                           (no auth by default)

# ── GIT HOSTING (Gitea/Gogs) — GITHOOK RCE ───────
# When you have an account on Gitea/Gogs:
#   1. Create a repository
#   2. Settings → Git Hooks → edit pre-receive/post-receive
#   3. Paste reverse shell
#   4. Clone repo and commit → triggers hook → shell
# Even self-registered accounts work if hooks are enabled.

# ── IMPORTANT: register when you can't log in ─────
# Many PG boxes have open registration on the login page.
# Creating your own account is faster than finding the admin password.
# Check for: /register  /signup  /user/sign_up  /account/register

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SPRAY TECHNIQUE: when you don't know the app
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Try these in order (30 seconds per attempt):
# 1. admin / admin
# 2. admin / password
# 3. admin / <blank>
# 4. root / root
# 5. admin / <appname>   (e.g. admin / grafana)
# 6. <appname> / <appname>   (e.g. pyload / pyload)
# 7. admin / <hostname>   (e.g. admin / pyloader)
# 8. guest / guest
# If all fail: searchsploit <appname> for unauthenticated exploits

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIND THE APP NAME / VERSION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
curl -s http://<IP>/ | grep -iE 'generator|powered by|copyright|version|title'
curl -si http://<IP>/ | grep -iE 'server|x-powered-by'
# Page footer usually has: 'Powered by X v0.9.7' or copyright
# That version → searchsploit
warn: Default credentials are the single highest-ROI check in a pentest. Do it before any enumeration on a login page — 30 seconds vs hours. Also check if the app has a registration page (self-registration) since creating your own account is often faster than finding the admin password. For headless services (Redis, MongoDB), test for no-auth access before trying credentials.

choices.label: Logged in — check version and search for exploits
Found the app — it's a web CMS
Default creds worked — use the credential
No default creds — try brute force
